# Primary sources for the amended execution

Kotte, V. (2026). EVICT: Evidence-sufficiency verification via counterfactual dropout for visually-grounded selective question answering. In *Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops* (pp.11251–11259). [Official paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026W/GRAIL-V/papers/Kotte_EVICT_Evidence-Sufficiency_Verification_via_Counterfactual_Dropout_for_Visually-Grounded_Selective_Question_CVPRW_2026_paper.pdf).

Jojic, M., Li, Z., & Zhou, B. (2026). *Don't just look, intervene: Perturbation based region labeling for VQA images* [Preprint]. arXiv. [Primary record](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13228).

Hugging Face. (n.d.). *SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct* [Model checkpoint and processor]. [Pinned source](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct/tree/482adb537c021c86670beed01cd58990d01e72e4).

OpenGVLab. (n.d.). *InternVL2_5-2B* [Model checkpoint and inference example]. [Pinned source](https://huggingface.co/OpenGVLab/InternVL2_5-2B/tree/573169ee54df216786bb9a189e9a32a060a008cf).

Qwen. (n.d.). *Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct* [Model checkpoint and processor]. [Pinned source](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct/tree/66285546d2b821cf421d4f5eb2576359d3770cd3).

LaMa, GQA, RefCOCOg, Transformers and earlier closest-paper source/license entries remain in `SOURCE_AUDIT.md` and [protocol source audit](../docs/06_REPRODUCIBILITY_AND_PRIOR_ART.md). No DOI is supplied where independently unverified. Model-card checkpoints are not benchmark reproductions. Local source/weight checksums are recorded separately from bibliographic sources.
